svg.title: Held-out validation scatter
svg.text: Does a higher score mean more owners? Held-out check
800 random games from the 5,415-game test split. Spearman rank correlation on the full test split: 0.725.
median score per actual owners tier
Actual owners tier on the x axis (SteamSpy ranges). Rising medians = the model orders games correctly on average; the spread is the uncertainty.
